cds.title: Western Carolina University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class. International first-year applicants 1,640, admitted only 118 (7%), enrolled 56 (C1 residency table), so WCU admits far fewer internationals than domestic applicants. Enrolled is left null: C1 reports 2,936 enrolled (residency table; men 1,272 + women 1,679) but the full-time/part-time split (1,895) and the C9 test-submission counts imply a class near 1,900. WCU says it receives 9-10 applications per fall first-year space. Undergraduate total 10,268 and nonresident-alien undergraduates 223 are from CDS B1/B2.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS 2025-2026 C8A: SAT/ACT recommended; WCU's admissions page requires a score only when the weighted high school GPA is below 2.80.

cost.notes: CDS 2025-2026 G1 (first-year, 2026-27): tuition $1,000 in-state, $7,000 out-of-state and international (NC Promise), required fees $3,598, housing $7,234 + food $5,799. H6: 81 undergraduate nonresidents received institutional aid (average $6,100, total $494,089); the CDS does not say whether it was need- or non-need-based.
